The '''[[Carbonite/Legends|Carbonite]] Run''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] established to get past the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] blockade of the [[Deep Core Security Zone/Legends|Deep Core Security Zone]]. It went from [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]], down the [[Daragon Trail]] to [[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]], and then to [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]].
